# Legal Formatters

## Summary
`formatDay(v)` renders `2026-10-15` from local date parts and `formatStamp(v)` adds `14:32`; both return `—` for an empty value and the raw value for an unparseable one. They build from local parts rather than `toISOString()`, which converts to UTC first and so renders a local date a day early or late depending on the offset — on a notice deadline, a day out is a missed obligation.

## Usage
```ts
import { formatDay } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/legal/format';

formatDay(contract.endDate); // "2027-01-14"
```

## Non-goals
No locale formatting; these are the unambiguous ISO-style forms.
